title: satk.seq.stepSeq
description: `satk.seq.stepSeq` is a 3-row, 16-step float sequencer for Pd, intended to sequence three value streams together with per-step activation. It can run from its internal BPM clock or be advanced externally, and supports forward, backward, pendulum, and random directions; its gate/trigger output can either remain high for a configurable percentage of each step or emit a short pulse at the step’s start.
